Summary: Confirms the hotfix remains narrowly scoped to the incident need and has not become an uncontrolled bundled release.
PassCriteria: Hotfix scope is minimal, incident-linked, and clearly separable from unrelated backlog or convenience changes.
FailCriteria: Emergency path includes unrelated opportunistic changes or unbounded side effects.
EscalationRule: Escalate immediately and reset the hotfix scope before deployment.
